_doc: Cortex LongMemEval benchmark baseline. The TS port must reproduce these scores within ±0.5 percentage points. CANONICAL SOURCE: the published Cortex numbers in docs/arxiv-thermodynamic/main.pdf (Table tab:benchmarks, Empirical Evidence) — LongMemEval R@10 98.4%, MRR 0.9124. Those are the two headline metrics the paper publishes. recall_at_5 and by_category below are NOT in the paper; they are kept as a conservative secondary gate from the empirical cortex_bench capture (cortex main, 2026-04-17) and are NOT load-bearing for the published claim. The published methodology (paper Empirical Evidence): clean PostgreSQL DB seeded only with the benchmark data, single process, the same recall_memories() PL/pgSQL code path as deployment — exactly what the cortex-longmemeval-pg runner exercises (NOT a custom retriever). Dataset: LongMemEval-S (Wu et al., ICLR 2025), 500 questions across 6 categories, ~40 sessions/question.
